topics.title: Murve’s Office Oddities
topics.summary: The broadcast details a chaotic scene involving comedian Toni Fields and Murve, who recounts bizarre interactions with various individuals regarding potential romantic interests and unusual requests. Conversations revolve around Hollywood aspirations, unsolicited advice about moving to Kansas or New York, an unsettling encounter where boys were invited into his room for ‘fun,’ and increasingly strange behavior from those he interacts with.

topics.title: Merv’s Helmsley Revelations
topics.summary: During a phone call, Howard discusses details of Merv Griffin’s stay at the Helmsley Palace hotel, including accounts from a doorman and subsequent callers describing young men in his suite. The conversation includes references to ‘Santa Baby,’ strip teasing, attempts to determine if Merv was exploiting wealth for escorts, and awkward discussions about physical appearance.

topics.title: Investment Discussions and a Biology Test
topics.summary: Two individuals discuss the potential investment value of a sealed copy of ‘Crucified by the FCC’ record, suggesting buying two copies for listening and sealing. They speculate on returns – from $29.95 to $300 in one year – while also referencing an unusual poll test given to adults regarding biology knowledge, revealing widespread misunderstanding among participants.

topics.title: Madonna Documentary Controversy and Callers
topics.summary: During a discussion about Madonna’s controversial documentary, callers debated the film's explicit content including simulated sexual acts and depictions of incest. The conversation frequently veered into personal anecdotes, misinterpretations of artistic intent, and humorous speculation regarding the identities and behaviors of those involved.

topics.title: Kirk Shaving & Parisian Revelations
topics.summary: During an interview, the host recounts being asked to shave Kirk while offering $500. The conversation shifts to frequent partying with Merv and Murv, including accounts of sexual encounters with young men and transgender individuals, alongside lavish parties in Paris and Rio de Janeiro involving celebrities like Rock Hudson and Ava Gabor.

Numerous callers share bizarre stories involving Murv—including claims of sexual activity with rats and relationships with Terry Gar and David Letterman—further escalating his delusional behavior.
